title: I dream about Vegas casino malls all the time.
content: I used to speak at conferences for my IT work in Vegas and my friends from around the world were with me. They were some of the best times of my life. My best most vivid dreams take place in the malls between those same hotels and the conference area. It’s an amazing dream adventure each time, much like my experiences in the past. I had another one last night. Thank you, brain, for allowing me to experience it again! But please please please stop having me run into my ex fiancé there. He’s always going to be a cheater. I wake up all nostalgic and heartbroken. Let’s just focus on the nostalgia part.
